contact.assumedModelScope: Actual evaluated saved native Catmull-Rom centre curves, circular local-radius cross sections under the saved affine object matrix. Common interior cross-section points, with numerical plane residuals and radial margins, falsify disjoint shaft volumes. No end-taper, whole-hair, body, dynamic or runtime pass.

retainedResearch.purpose: Finer filament front-view reference, actual source-material ablation, preserved-data/guide-mean lineage and native-model contact failure. Not an accepted working hair layer.
retainedResearch.minimumIntegrationStep: Reconstruct parent-family offsets without the converging transported interpolation, then inspect the same complete woman and affected contact/motion.
retainedResearch.notAccepted: Full hairstyle realism, anatomical follicles, self/body continuous contact, natural dynamics, physical scattering or engine.

primaryPaper.title: Quantifying whole human hair scalp fibres of varying curl: A micro-computed tomographic study
primaryPaper.table: Table5 FDAS, medium curl/typeIV major79.3um and minor49.2um.
primaryPaper.interpretation: Equivalent circular area diameter=sqrt(79.3*49.2)=62.463um. This is a limited sample reference, not a universal or population-calibrated biological model.

scattering.use: Pigmented absorbing core with dielectric reflection/transmission; typical IOR1.55, cuticle offset2degrees. No PBRT code imported.

references.authoringChoices: Seven circular render fibres per former coarse strand; original guide centerline retained. Six ring offsets chosen from diameter and1.5um shaft gap. Distal native-segment taper is authored, not a measurement from the paper. No follicle anatomy, contact or natural motion inherited.
